title: 格擋閃避判定研究室
description: 精準格擋、精準閃避的判定研究：逐幀分析模式可自訂互動、判定窗、結果與效果，用幀數條與判定紀錄拆解每一次按鍵；實戰試玩模式用同一組規則玩子彈格擋小遊戲。

en.title: Parry & dodge timing lab
en.description: Perfect parry and perfect dodge timing, two ways: a frame-by-frame lab to customize interactions, timing windows, outcomes and effects and inspect every input, and a playable bullet-parry game running on the same rules.
